mapper.select: SELECT /*+ LEADING(T1 S1) USE_NL(S1) */ T1.userid, T1.username, T1.brth, T1.email, T1.regdate, T1.grade, S1.pfnum AS pfnum, S1.pcnum AS pcnum, S1.pbnum AS pbnum FROM SM01 T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SMI1 S1 ON T1.userid = S1.userid AND S1.infocode = 1 WHERE T1.brth = #{brth} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT /*+ UNNEST NL_AJ */ 1 FROM SME1 E1 WHERE T1.userid = E1.userid )

SELECT /*+ LEADING(T1 S1) USE_NL(S1) INDEX(T1 idx_SM01_1) */ T1.userid, T1.username, T1.brth, T1.email, T1.regdate, T1.grade, S1.pfnum AS pfnum, S1.pcnum AS pcnum, S1.pbnum AS pbnum FROM SM01 T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SMI1 S1 ON T1.userid = S1.userid AND S1.infocode = 1 WHERE T1.username LIKE #{username} || '%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT /*+ UNNEST NL_AJ */ 1 FROM SME1 E1 WHERE T1.userid = E1.userid )
